name: Can molding installation help improve home insulation or energy efficiency in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Can molding installation help improve home insulation or energy efficiency in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: While molding itself isn't a primary insulation material, properly installed baseboards and crown molding can play a minor role in improving energy efficiency, particularly in older homes common across the Bay Area, including cities like Pacifica and South San Francisco. By sealing small gaps between walls and floors or ceilings, molding can help prevent drafts and reduce minor air leaks. This contributes to a more consistent indoor temperature, potentially reducing heating or cooling demands. However, its main function remains aesthetic, with any insulation benefits being secondary to proper wall and window insulation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Molding can minimally improve energy efficiency by sealing small gaps in older Bay Area homes, reducing drafts, but its primary function is aesthetic.
